notes: Anthropic first-party API list prices, standard (not batch, not fast mode, no inference_geo multiplier).
A tier applies when the request's whole prompt (uncached input + cache reads + cache writes) is <= max_prompt; null = no limit.
Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length: over 100,000 prompt tokens the whole request pays the higher tier.
Cache reads on Claude Sonnet 5.5 are 0.05x base input (footnote 2 on the pricing page).
The brain marks 5-minute (ephemeral) cache breakpoints, so writes are priced at cache_write_5m.
